summary: Michael James Kroll, 41, reported missing in Pagosa Springs after last being seen leaving work Oct 16; search by Pagosa Springs PD, Archuleta County SO, Upper San Juan SAR and Southern Ute Ranger Division found nothing; his skeletal remains were found by hikers Sept 25, 2022 near Middle Mountain Rd northeast of Vallecito Reservoir and DNA-identified in Jan 2023; a suspect was later arrested on a murder charge
responding_agency: Archuleta County Sheriff Office; Upper San Juan Search and Rescue; Southern Ute Ranger Division; Pagosa Springs Police Department
notes: Dated SAR search confirmed: USJSAR + Archuleta County SO participated in the Oct 2021 search. Recorded at the missing/search date (Stehling-row convention). Remains located 2022-09-25 near Middle Mountain Rd (CR 2274), ~60 mi NW of Pagosa Springs in La Plata County; CBI Forensic Lab + La Plata County Coroner identified via DNA on Jan 6, 2023. Glen Canyon Lee Hunt, 60, arrested Aug 2025 on a second-degree murder charge (internewscast = Denver7 mirror). PD release spells the name "Micheal"; Denver7 spells "Michael" — same person (DOB 07/20/1980). Kroll, a Joplin, MO resident, had lived in Pagosa Springs a short time; he had left his job at the Humane Society Thrift Store on Oct 16 with his dog. Search outcome published 2021-10-21 per PD statement.
